human_feedback_summary: Text evidence cards in straight rectangular panels should use visually centered body text rather than top-heavy text anchoring.
Figures placed inside wide bottom evidence panels should use the panel space aggressively while preserving source aspect ratio.
Figure captions in wide panels should be centered under the fitted image.
Dense or long tables should be converted into a focused readable table view rather than rendering unreadable source-width tables.
Focused table views should include a top label and a centered explanatory caption when the source table has usable context.
Tables and images should be judged by actual space use and readability, not only by raw metadata finding counts.

full-width top claim band plus wide lower proof panel for figure/table evidence pages
